description: Developed production-ready mobile and web applications used by real users. Built a React Native mobile application from scratch and a Next.js web dashboard. Designed, developed, and maintained backend services using Flask and Node.js with PostgreSQL, including REST API development, authentication, and database integration. Implemented Python-based web scraping pipelines for data collection and processing. Worked on backend performance optimization, system reliability, and API efficiency.

Building and maintaining backend services for internal and user-facing applications. Designed and developed REST APIs using Express.js and Supabase, handling authentication, database operations, and business logic. Worked with Supabase for managed PostgreSQL, authentication, and data storage. Contributed to frontend development using React and Next.js by implementing features, fixing bugs, and improving application workflows. Collaborated with team members to ensure scalable architecture, clean code, and smooth integration between frontend and backend systems.
